title: Homogeneous Freudenthal algebras and the first Tits construction
summary: Freudenthal algebras over a field are basically the same as Jordan algebras of degree $3$ remaining simple under all base field extensions. These algebras are intimately linked, via their automorphism groups and structure groups, to simple algebraic groups over arbitrary fields. Our main concern here will be the question of when these algebras are homogeneous in the sense that all their Jordan isotopes are isomorphic.
